subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose Gateway update execution to HTTP-authenticated operator callers, and if so should that be a new `/admin/update` endpoint or an allowlisted Admin HTTP RPC wrapper around `update.run`?
rationale: The request expands host package-update and restart authority from existing Gateway control-plane paths to an HTTP surface, and also asks for target-version semantics that current `update.run` does not support.

options.title: Split and design first
options.body: Keep version metadata in the narrower canonical issue and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before adding HTTP update execution.

options.title: Expose through Admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Add `update.run` or a narrow wrapper to the disabled-by-default Admin HTTP RPC plugin with explicit trusted-ingress, auth, audit, rate-limit, handoff, and target-version proof requirements.

options.title: Decline HTTP update execution
options.body: Keep update execution limited to CLI/WebSocket/control-plane paths and document that fleet tools should use those or an external orchestrator.

recommendation.title: Split and design first
recommendation.body: Keep version metadata in the narrower canonical issue and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before adding HTTP update execution.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product/security boundary decision across Gateway update flow and Admin HTTP RPC, both areas tied to this owner history.
